provenance.bootstrap: installed2.2.73 used only to fetch334pinned objects and compile all snapshotcomponents
provenance.dependencySource: full private copy of installed node_modules; absolute workspace links rerouted; no hardlinks into live outputs

method: near-simultaneous sampled RSS sum, including GNU time wrapper and observed command descendants; driver excluded
caveats: shared pages are counted for each process
short-lived processes and between-sample peaks can be missed
OS and private V8 compile caches are warm

memory.method: near-simultaneous sampled sum of Linux /proc VmRSS for the command process and observed descendants
